title: Event
description: The envelope of every employee input (event.Event). It states the rules of event.Event.Validate, with unknown fields rejected, for the JSON encoding; Validate alone decides the edges: null fields, a zero time written with an offset, a malformed time (format only annotates) and non-ASCII spaces such as U+0085. Catalog.Route then adds the rules of the type: a known type, class and mode that agree with the catalog, a scene id when the type requires one, a human actor in the foreground and the type's session_key ref.

id.description: Stable per producer; a replay carries the same content.

employee.description: Addressed employee when a producer serves several.

class.description: Derived from the catalog: business, execution, completion, schedule or enablement. Route rejects a value that disagrees with it.

mode.description: Derived from the catalog: triggered or listening. Route rejects a value that disagrees with it.

scene.description: Absent or empty for employee-wide events; Route requires an id when the type requires a scene.

id.description: Host-minted scene id; the only key of per-scene state.

kind.description: group, dm, enterprise or a Host kind.

locator.description: Provider identity for display and calls, never a state key.

actor.description: Absent or empty when no actor is known; Route requires a human actor in the foreground.

occurred_at.description: RFC 3339; the zero time (Go's unset time.Time) is rejected.
